81659: Yamagami's first name is so long it is often abbreviated to just "Lucy". Her parents had difficulty choosing a name and listed all the ideas on the registration form.
81675: A 3rd generation city employee, who works at the city welfare department, he is assigned to the 1st section that issues nursing certifications.
81677: She is a shy and passive newly hired city employee, who, along with her fellow newbies Hasebe and Yamagami works at the city welfare department.
81679: A social service employee who is actually working as a temporary employee with a shorter shift than others. She is rather aloof towards her co-workers, and is revealed to be an avid fan of the magical girl series Magical Flowers.
81681: Taishi is a supervisor in the health and welfare office and the one in charge of Lucy and her friends. Although kind and approachable, Taishi is prone to be bossed around, particularly by his sister.
81683: Taishi's tsundere younger sister, noted for having a peculiar marking under her right eye similar to the "bulging vein" image used to depict a person when angry. Staying true to this quirky trait, Tōhko is often in a bad mood and has a short temper.
188751: The Section Chief of the Health and Welfare Department. He is first introduced as a talking stuffed rabbit in episode 4 due to his extreme shyness.
188752: The daughter of Kenzou Momoi. People say that she resembles him. She is also friends with Touko Ichimiya.
188754: An old lady living in the ward who frequents the office to visit Miyoshi. She always talks about her daughter-in-law and has a grandson who happens to be Yutaka's childhood friend and rival.
